episodes.174729: Storm force northwest wind gusts were recorded at the Stannard Rock Light C-MAN station during the evening of the 19th.
episodes.175787: A warm front lifting north across South Florida along with east winds from the Atlantic provided support for rounds of heavy showers across SE Florida.
episodes.175788: A warm front lifting north across South Florida along with east winds from the Atlantic provided support for rounds of heavy showers across SE Florida and the adjacent Atlantic coast.

events.county: Manitou Island To Marquette Mi And W Of Grand Marais Mi To Us/Canadian Border Beyond 5Nm Of Shore
events.narrative: The Stannard Rock Light station recorded storm force northwest wind gusts throughout much of the period with a peak gust to 49 knots.
Streets in the Allapattah neighborhood of Miami were flooded from heavy rainfall. About 2 inches of rain fell in the area, most of it falling in an hour or less.

An off-duty NWS meteorologist reported water above curb level and halfway up car tires at the intersection of SW 3rd Avenue and SW 6th Street in the Brickell neighborhood of Miami. About 2 to 3 inches of rain fell in the area.

Reports of standing water due to several rounds of heavy rainfall were received from the Village of Pinecrest, mainly in the Pinecrest by the Sea neighborhood. Rainfall totals of 5 to 7 inches were observed in the area.
Street flooding was reported across the city of Doral, mostly causing partial lane closures. Rainfall totals were in the 3 to 4 inch range across the city.

events.county: Deerfield Beach To Ocean Reef Fl
events.narrative: A thunderstorm wind gust of 41 knots (47 mph) was measured at the WxFlow site XDAN at Dania Beach Pier.

events.county: Jupiter Inlet To Deerfield Beach Fl Out 20Nm
events.narrative: A thunderstorm wind gust of 42 knots (48 mph) was measured at the WxFlow site XJUP at Juno Beach Pier.

Reports from emergency managers and broadcast media of significant flooding in Miami Shores, Biscayne Park, and North Miami. Water entered the garage of a home in Miami Shores, and several reports of significant street flooding leading to stalled vehicles across these areas. Rainfall amounts of 4 to 6 inches were received from the area.

Street flooding was observed in the Edgewater neighborhood of Miami, generally from NE 15th Street to NE 29th Street east of Biscayne Boulevard to the bayfront. Cars were stalled on Biscayne Boulevard between NE 11th and 15th streets. Rainfall amounts of around 4 inches were reported in the area.
